title: UnecePaymentDiscountTerms
description: Trade terms and conditions by which a discount is or can be applied to a payable amount.

actualDiscountAmount.description: A monetary value of the actual discount in these trade payment discount terms.

basisAmount.description: A monetary value used as a basis to calculate the discount in these trade payment discount terms.

basisDateTime.description:
The date, time, date time, or other date time value used as the basis to calculate the discount in the trade payment
discount terms.

basisPeriodMeasure.description: The measure of the basis period for these trade payment discount terms.

calculationPercent.description: The percent used to calculate the discount in these trade payment discount terms.
